# Leaflet 1.9.4

Unmodified distribution files from `leaflet@1.9.4`, including the original BSD-2-Clause license in [LICENSE](LICENSE). CSS images and the JavaScript source map are included.

The Guangxi page loads these local files only when the map tab is opened. A stalled external CDN cannot block the itinerary's initial HTML or interactive controls.

- [Official downloads and self-hosting instructions](https://leafletjs.com/download.html)
- Package source: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/leaflet@1.9.4/`
- Official JavaScript SHA-256 (base64): `20nQCchB9co0qIjJZRGuk2/Z9VM+kNiyxNV1lvTlZBo=`
- Official stylesheet SHA-256 (base64): `p4NxAoJBhIIN+hmNHrzRCf9tD/miZyoHS5obTRR9BMY=`
